title: Classify only at a role-less tick's first dispatch: a later attempt with no record must not ask
body: internal/reconcile/dispatch.go claimDispatch calls classificationFor on every implement-tick claim, after counting failed prior attempts, and classificationFor asks whenever no record exists and a classifier is set. The comment there says 'at the FIRST DISPATCH ... and nowhere else' and the classify.go header says 'never configured' is recorded, but a nil classifier records nothing. So a run whose attempt 1 ran with no classifier and failed, resumed with one, asks at attempt 2 and dispatches at dear_tier plus one rung (e.g. strong) where the warm process dispatches at default plus one (balanced). That is a cold/warm divergence driven by state outside git, plus a rung the failure never earned. Fix: ask only when the tick has no prior attempt (otherwise read-or-fallback), or record a 'no classifier configured' no-answer at first dispatch; add a restart test where the classifier's presence changes between incarnations.
